verdict.rationale: Bulk operations across many items, such as mass-editing monitors or bulk-muting, are a fair axis for an observability SaaS platform. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any bulk or batch capability. The API reference, MCP server, and CLI entries are general surfaces and never mention acting on many items at once, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
